frequencyResponse.notes: Mackie CR3 owner's manual (pdf-manuals.com copy): '(-3 dB) 70 Hz - 20 kHz' for the CR3 column. The (-10 dB) 80 Hz figure is a different measure and is not stored as the response.

power.notes: Mackie CR3 owner's manual: 'Rated Power 28 watts rms' (Class AB amplifier, CR3 column). The 50 W peak figure is not stored as rated power.

woofer.notes: Mackie CR3 owner's manual: 'Low Frequency 3.0 in / 76 mm polypropylene-coated woofer [CR3]'.

notes: No source-backed physical specification is retained for this exact model. Unknown values remain N/A rather than inferred. Pass-128 check (2026-10-10): Mackie official page not located for the exact CR3. Retailer and review copies (80 Hz-20 kHz, 97 dB max SPL, 50 W) are not field sources and CR3 variants exist; none transferred. Pass-130 check (2026-10-10): retailer listings only (80 Hz–20 kHz, 97 dB max SPL, 50 W). No mackie.com CR3 page or archive was reached. Nothing stored. Pass-135 check (2026-10-10): a distributor-hosted Mackie CR3 spec sheet (dubaimachines.com, 'Mackie CR3 Specs') gives: active 2-way, LF 1 x 3 in, HF 1 x 0.75 in, 'Frequency Response 70 Hz to 20 kHz ±3 dB', 'Frequency Range 80 Hz to 20 Hz ±10 dB', 'Power Rating 28 W RMS / 50 W Peak', max SPL 97 dB. Review copies give 80 Hz–20 kHz. The mackie.com CR3 URL returned an error page. The CR3 vs CR3-X naming is not resolved, and the sheet is a distributor copy with its own internal inconsistency, so nothing is stored. Pass-136 check (2026-10-10): The B&H listing for the Mackie CR3 (Class-AB active 2-way, 3 in woofer, 0.75 in tweeter, 28 W RMS / 50 W peak) is internally inconsistent: it gives "–3 dB 80–20,000 Hz; –10 dB 70–20,000 Hz" and also "70 Hz to 20 kHz ± 3 dB". The CR3-X (Class-D, 50 W peak; 80 Hz at −3 dB, 70 Hz at −10 dB) is a different revision. The revision and the response statement are unresolved, so no values are stored. Pass-138 check (2026-10-10): Mackie CR3 owner's manual (combined CR3 and CR4 manual; text copy at pdf-manuals.com; the zikinf.com copy was behind a verification challenge and was read only through its search index). For CR3 the table gives frequency response (-3 dB) 70 Hz-20 kHz and (-10 dB) 80 Hz-20 kHz; amplifier rated power 28 W RMS (Class AB), with 50 W peak; low-frequency driver 3.0 in (76 mm) and high-frequency driver 0.75 in silk dome, 3 kHz crossover (2 drivers); powered. Stored: -3 dB 70 Hz-20 kHz; 28 W RMS amplifier output; woofer 3.0 in; driverCount 2; active true. Not stored: the 97 dB figure in these copies is labelled 'Maximum SPL Peak Per Pair', not sensitivity; the -10 dB 80 Hz figure is not stored as the response; the 50 W peak is not converted or stored as rated power. The Class-D 50 W, 80 Hz at -3 dB text in earlier copies belongs to a different revision and is not merged.
